name: four_dataset_11_model_final_report

datasets.METRLA: excluded from the active four-dataset study; historical artifacts are retained

models.STFiT: incomplete under the fixed resource budget after CUDA OOM; no incomplete metric is reported
models.MCPST_FSL: incomplete under the fixed resource budget because the source-style dense spectral computation was impractically slow; no incomplete metric is reported

validation_reproducibility_tolerance.reason: float32/CUDA checkpoint replay; both tolerances must hold through math.isclose and are far below the 0.001 reporting precision

validation_policy: every checkpoint is independently rescored at its own seed and must agree with the training-time 33-cell table
test_policy: test is evaluated only after all 132 validation gates pass, with checkpoint scaler and zero teacher forcing
